top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Sinks 4.5% as Chipmaker Selloff Deepens: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A post-election slide in chipmakers snowballed, dragging the Nasdaq 100 down 4.5%, as investors bailed from the sector on speculation congressional Democrats will clamp down on the artificial-intelligence industry.

top_signals.title: ‘The blood is in the streets’: Nasdaq plunges as US midterms rattle SpaceX and Nvidia
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq index was plunging into the red on Thursday after the US midterms rattled AI-related stocks including Nvidia, Oracle and SpaceX.
